# Assumption of Moses Chapter 9 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** Taxo and His Sons: Martyrdom as Witness

---

**1** Then there will be a man from the tribe of Levi, whose name is Taxo, who will have seven sons.

**2** He will speak to them saying: See, my sons, a second cruel punishment has come upon the people, which is pitiless and more fierce than the first.

**3** Come, hear me, my sons, and understand.

**4** Our fathers and their fathers have tested God three times and have endured the afflictions of their souls.

**5** But never yet in the history of our nation has one come so righteous and pure as our ancestors.

**6** Let us fast for three days and on the fourth day enter a cave which is in the open country, and let us die there rather than transgress the commandments of the Lord of lords, the God of our fathers.

**7** If we do this and die thus, our blood will be avenged before the Lord.

**8** For from our blood the Lord will take vengeance upon these kings of the earth who have shed the blood of his saints.

**9** Then his dominion shall appear throughout all his creation, and then Satan will be no more, and sorrow shall be removed with him.

**10** Then the hands of the heavenly messenger, who has been appointed the highest and is appointed from the beginning, shall be filled, and he will immediately avenge them of their enemies.
